missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Преступник' is an animate masculine noun in the nominative case, the subject of the sentence. 'Опасный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'пойман' is the short-form participle.

Strategic focus: Accusative of animate noun. 'Преступника' takes the genitive-like ending because it is animate masculine, serving as the direct object of 'поймала'. 'Опасного' agrees in the same animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Преступника' is the genitive form after 'у', marking the criminal as the possessor. 'Алиби' is the indeclinable subject of 'не было'.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Преступнику' is the dative form, the indirect object receiving the sentence. 'Приговор' is the accusative thing handed down by the judge.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after предлог. 'Преступником' is the instrumental form after 'с', required by 'столкнулся', meaning he ran into the criminal. The verb agrees in the masculine.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after предлог. 'Преступнике' is the prepositional form after 'о', the topic written about. 'Газеты' is the nominative plural subject of 'писали'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Преступники' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'скрылись'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'давно' marks the time.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural of animate noun. 'Преступников' takes the genitive-plural ending because it is animate, serving as the object of 'арестовала'. 'Всех' agrees in the animate accusative plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive after предлог. 'Преступника' is the genitive form required by 'без', expressing the absence of the criminal. The clause states the consequence.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after бояться. 'Преступников' is the genitive plural required by 'боятся', which governs the genitive. 'Опасных' agrees in the genitive plural.
